content: Nimbrel server SDK 4.x (docs.nimbrel.example/sdk/updates, read 2026-04-20): by default the SDK polls for flag rules every 30 seconds and the polling interval cannot be set below 10 seconds; push updates need stream: true in the client options and are available only on the Team plan or above.
The host tallis runs the nightly backup cron at 02:30 UTC; backups land in /srv/backup/daily and are kept for 9 days.
mobile-app: the iOS build fails when a file name in the asset catalog contains a space; rename the file.
